description: Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Department - Notifying that the Report of Environmental Impacts Assessment Study of proposed 136 units of Residential Apartment Complex, Randombe North, Balapitiya be available for inspection from 10.12.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the public inspection and comment period for an Environmental Impact Assessment Report, which is a regulatory requirement under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resources Management Act. It deals with legal/regulatory procedures for environmental compliance and does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or elections.
